You can call in the faucet with your brand new account, and ask for money 2. The faucet can now do its own job of keeping track of which addresses it sent money to, store a record on chain or send an event. 3. ok, now that's a bit out there, but we could even have the signed message you send into auth be formed after a signed message that's taken after the private key of the wallet account, thereby having the ability to only allow calls if we are authorized by the faucet.
